themes.name: Digital Civic Access
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve residents’ access to municipal information or services through digital tools, in-person assistance for digital services, unified service channels, public connectivity, or open city data.

themes.name: Affordable and Efficient Housing
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they create, preserve, regulate, make transparent, or improve the affordability, supply, or energy performance of homes.

themes.name: Schools and Youth Learning
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve school staffing, facilities, class conditions, meals, tutoring, or children’s arts education.

themes.name: Public Culture and Recreation
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they expand access to cultural events, museums, libraries, public art, playgrounds, dog areas, or other shared recreational amenities.

themes.name: Environmental Sustainability and Green Space
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they reduce pollution or waste, produce clean energy, monitor environmental conditions, or add urban greenery and community growing spaces.

themes.name: Neighborhood Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they prevent crime or injuries, improve street safety or lighting, strengthen community policing, or shorten fire and ambulance response times.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they expand preventive, primary, specialist, mental-health, or at-home care services for residents.

themes.name: Public Transport and Cycling
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they improve bus operations, transit fares or rider information, or safe cycling infrastructure.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals belong here if they build workers’ skills, require local hiring, support independent workers, simplify business permits, or finance small businesses.
